# PowerDealDesk
> Subscription research service (powered by Regenify) tracking Australian National Electricity Market (NEM) battery storage (BESS) and solar+BESS hybrid development projects for buyers: IPPs, infrastructure funds and family offices. Public data is sourced to AEMO Generation Information and state planning records. Contact: deals@powerdealdesk.com

## Key pages
- [Australia home, plans and free brief](https://powerdealdesk.com/au/)
- [Australian NEM battery & hybrid project tracker (public, sourced table)](https://powerdealdesk.com/au/nem-bess-tracker/)
- State trackers: [NSW](https://powerdealdesk.com/au/nsw/), [QLD](https://powerdealdesk.com/au/qld/), [VIC](https://powerdealdesk.com/au/vic/), [SA](https://powerdealdesk.com/au/sa/)
